numeric.input: finite IEEE754 binary16 raw full-dimensional already-RoPE Q and K
numeric.producer: caller retains the explicitly selected query source; no kernel query substitution,skew,mask,channel selection,normalization or selector
numeric.accumulation: binary32 addition in channel order0..127,initial+0,no reassociation
numeric.host_validation: reject nonfinite inputs and nonfinite output as required by the policy; no fallback

limits.invalid_token_count: no memory accesses;host must reject before launch

implementation.independent_score_interleaving: 16token accumulators;one update per lane every16 loop iterations
implementation.arithmetic_parallelism_note: only independent query heads/tokens;each score retains sequential128-channel arithmetic

compatibility: NOT compatible with HS_PARTIAL_F16_V1 arguments,layout,query artifacts or xclbin
